note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003), the text the shipped Amharic house books quote. Its New Testament is on disk whole (ebible mirror, bibles/amh_amh via scripts/bible_mirror.py); the mirror carries no Old Testament, so OT quotations reuse the wording of an already-shipped Amharic work where one quotes the same verse (source_file names it) and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register.

The English quotes the BSB, except where a story gives the words a person heard (Spurgeon's KJV Isaiah 45:22). The Amharic keeps the 1962 wording throughout; Isaiah 45:22 uses the shipped cheque-book.am.json form with ተመልከቱ ('look'), which the chapter's whole point turns on. The 1962 printed text reads ወደ እኔ ዘወር በሉ (as talks-to-the-farmer.am.json quotes it) — a native reviewer should confirm the 'look' form. The chapter's second, 'modern translation' rendering of the verse is self_rendered and deliberately different.

1 Timothy 4:12 is inside a bridged 4:11-13 entry in the mirror and has no shipped Amharic rendering, so it is self_rendered. Daniel 5:27 reuses Richard Allen's own Amharic edition (ጐድለህም); the 1962 Bible reads ቀልለህም.
A mined row was checked as an exact substring of the cited source (1962 NT verse or corpus file) inside the named block.
